name: cloudflare-ai-usage-dashboard
description: AI and Cloudflare usage dashboard: a Worker that collects usage every 5 minutes and serves an animated dashboard.

scripts.demo: node scripts/seed-demo.mjs && wrangler dev --persist-to .wrangler/demo --local-upstream localhost --var ENVIRONMENT:development --var CONFIG_PROFILE:example

DB.description: D1 database for usage rollups. Created for you.

CF_ACCOUNT_ID.description: Your Cloudflare **account ID** (dashboard → account home → right sidebar).

CF_API_TOKEN.description: A **read-only** API token scoped to this account: `Account Analytics: Read`, `D1: Read`, `Workers KV Storage: Read`, `Queues: Read`, `Workers Scripts: Read`. See the [README](https://github.com/WeaveHubHQ/cloudflare-ai-usage-dashboard#1-create-a-read-only-cloudflare-api-token).

ANTHROPIC_ADMIN_KEY.description: Optional. Anthropic **Admin** key (`sk-ant-admin01-…`) for direct Claude API usage. Enter `none` to skip.

OPENAI_ADMIN_KEY.description: Optional. OpenAI **Admin** key restricted to usage read. Enter `none` to skip.

CONFIG_PROFILE.description: Which `config/<profile>.json` maps your resources to apps. Start with `example`.
